all-approved: Every served tool and the instructions match the lock.
stdio-package-approved: Stdio server identified by its npm coordinate.
new-tool: A served tool has no entry in the shard.
changed-tool: A served tool's digest differs from the approved one.
no-digest-tool: A served tool contains 2^53 and has no digest.
duplicate-name: Two served tools share a name; every copy is withheld.
unlocked-server: No shard for this identity; everything withheld.
monitor-unlocked-server: Unlocked server under monitor: shown, flagged.
removed-tool: An approved tool is absent from the listing; reported only.
monitor-shows-all: Monitor shows every tool and flags each reason.
strict-is-guard: strict behaves as guard in draft 1.
unknown-top-level-key: Shard carries a member draft 1 does not define.
unknown-tool-entry-field: Tool entry carries an unknown member.
duplicate-key-in-shard: Lock files with duplicate member names are unreadable.
contract-tampered: Contract bytes no longer hash to their filename.
contract-filename-mismatch: Entry points at a valid contract for another digest.
shard-h16-mismatch: Shard identity does not hash to the filename's h16.
symlinked-shard: Shard is a symlink (created from setup.json).
alias-command-traversal: aliases.json maps a name to a command path, not a basename.
aliases-ok: A well-formed aliases.json does not change the check.
unexpected-file: A file in .mcp/lock that the layout does not define.
manifest-ok: Manifest present, required by host config, and correct.
manifest-extra-file: A shard on disk is not listed in MANIFEST.json.
manifest-missing-file: MANIFEST.json lists a file that is not on disk.
manifest-hash-mismatch: A shard changed after MANIFEST.json was written.
manifest-required-missing: Host requires a manifest; none present.
sequence-rollback: Signer configured; sequence below the last accepted value.
call-before-listing: Calls before any listing are refused.
calls: Calls to an approved, a withheld and an unlisted tool.
